description: For every two actual relation clauses \(C,D\) and substitutions \(\sigma,\tau\) into a common alphabet, their fresh copies satisfy \(C^e\gamma=C\sigma\) and \(D^o\gamma=D\tau\) for the specified combined substitution \(\gamma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.copies_substitute.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (C D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L ℕ) (σ τ : ℕ → L.Term α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.combine σ τ)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.leftCopy C) =
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst σ C ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.combine σ τ)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.rightCopy D) =
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst τ D
